description: Jordan is holding their late grandfather's remaining woodworking tools and must decide which family member will receive each item, where the largest tool will be kept, and how the handoff will happen after checking in with the other two relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family is keeping three of their grandfather's workshop items: a benchtop planer, a scroll saw, and a locked chest of hand tools.
shared_context.S2: Jordan is storing the items temporarily and will make the final decisions about who receives each one.
shared_context.S3: The family wants the items to remain with relatives rather than being sold.
shared_context.S4: The planer is too large for ordinary car transport and needs a secure, level place to be kept.
shared_context.S5: Before settling the arrangement, Jordan's usual practice is to check with each relative for plans, space, or other practical details that should shape the decision.

PF1.text: Mina has promised to use the planer to build an accessibility ramp for their aunt, and her garage has a clear 120-centimeter west bench beside a 240-volt outlet; she has not yet told Jordan.

PF2.text: Caleb is restoring the unfinished birdhouse their grandfather started and specifically needs the grandfather's scroll saw for that project; he has a dry 90-centimeter shelf where it can remain set up, but he has not yet told Jordan.

acceptance_conditions: Mina must receive the benchtop planer.
The planer must be kept on Mina's west garage bench beside the 240-volt outlet.
Caleb must receive the scroll saw.
Jordan must retain the locked chest of hand tools.
A commitment to transport and secure the planer at Mina's garage must exist.
A commitment to keep the scroll saw set up for Caleb's birdhouse restoration must exist.
Caleb's birdhouse project must be cited as justification for the scroll saw assignment.

decisive_facts.why: Mina's ramp promise and the exact 120-centimeter bench beside a 240-volt outlet change the planer recipient to A2, its storage location to A2_west_garage_bench, and the need for the matching transport commitment.
Caleb's unfinished birdhouse project changes the scroll saw recipient to A3 and requires a commitment to keep that saw set up for the project, while supplying the fact that must be cited.
